text:
Priya M.: Quick sync: found a few confusing spots where the consoleuses different labels for the same thing. Nav says `Help & Support`, the docs sidecar header says `Guides`, and some CTAs say `View docs`. Users get lost.
Jordan L.: Oof. We should pick a single lexicon. Leaning toward `Guides` internally? But `Docs` matches external site SEO.
June (design): I sketched a compromise: top-level nav = `Help`, sidecar header = `Guides` with a small sublabel `Console docs & examples`. Keeps nav discoverable and sidecar contextual.
Ravi S.: From an analytics standpoint we have three different events: help_click, guides_opened, docs_viewed. Consolidation will be annoying but doable. We need a migration plan so historical dashboards don't break.
docs-bot: New docs page created: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/lexicon-recs (author: @June (design)) :spiral_notepad:  
Priya M.: Accessibility nit: screen reader announces the drawer as "Dialog" and repeats the site title; the toggle lacks aria-expanded and a label. Suggested small change:
```
<button id="help-drawer-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="help-drawer" aria-label="Open console help">Help</button>
```
June (design): Nice. Also propose adding a visually hidden H1 inside the drawer: `Visually hidden: Console guides and API reference` so SR users get context.
Jordan L.: Cross-link behavior is inconsistent. Internal anchors (example: #batching) open a new tab to docs.redwood.ai and don't open the sidecar. Users expect in-console deep link where possible. Proposal: try sidecar deep-link first, fallback to new tab.
Ravi S.: Implementation sketch: intercept click, check if sidecar feature flag enabled and model-info present, then call `sidecar.open({anchor})`. Emit an event `docs_deeplink` with anchor and fallback boolean. Add unit tests.
June (design): UX detail: when we deep link into the sidecar, highlight the target heading for 3s and add a `Back to console` quick link at the top. Helps orientation.
Priya M.: Microcopy swap: use `Open help` for nav CTA, `Open guides` in-drawer, and `View full docs` for external links. Keeps copy short and consistent.
Jordan L.: Works for me. We should also update the Console onboarding tour language to use the new terms.
Ravi S.: I'll own the analytics migration (events map + shim layer). June, can you update the Figma frames and add the hidden H1?
June (design): On it. PR with copy updates + accessibility checklist will land today.
Priya M.: Great. Can we have a tiny RFC in #product-ship by EOD Wednesday with owners for copy, infra, analytics, and a rollout plan (feature flag + GA)?
Jordan L.: I will file the RFC and tag @Ravi @June.
Priya M.: Thanks team :thumbsup:
